_about: Betty's voice evals (2026-10-19). Each case: the ride situation the app would send, what he said, and what a good answer must do. tools = must be called (any order); tools: [] = must answer WITHOUT a tool; omit tools = either is fine. args = a tool argument must contain this text. fixtures = what each tool returns in this test (no real calls, so results are repeatable). facts = what the judge checks the answer against. Add a case for every bad answer found in a ride log.

cases.said: Who wrote Animal Farm?

cases.said: Is the diamond mine tour open on Sundays?

web_search.answer: Cullinan Diamond Mine surface tours run daily including Sundays, at 10:30 and 14:00; booking is recommended. Adults about R170.

cases.facts: Yes, daily including Sundays, 10:30 and 14:00, about R170, book ahead.

cases.said: What's the history of Dremiston?

web_search.answer: Germiston was founded in 1887 after the gold discovery and named by John Jack after his Scottish birthplace farm near Glasgow; it became a major railway junction.

cases.facts: Treats 'Dremiston' as Germiston: founded 1887 in the gold rush, named by John Jack after a farm near Glasgow, a big railway junction.

cases.said: I think I'm lost, how do I get back on the route?
cases.facts: She cannot give directions: says he is about 0.6 km off the route and that Google Maps on his screen will get him back. No turn-by-turn, no offer to guide.

cases.said: Tell me something about this place.
cases.facts: A fact from the area notes, e.g. the 3,106-carat Cullinan Diamond found here in 1905, or the town named after Sir Thomas Cullinan. Told as her own knowledge.

cases.said: How are you doing, Betty?
cases.facts: A short, warm, dry reply in character. No ride statistics he did not ask for.
